title: KillCredits+
description: This mod adds kill credits for more specific situations!
body:
This mod adds missing kill credits to some specific situations!

When you kill someone in Minecraft, it has a chat message announcing how the death happened and who caused it, however in some specific situations like listed below, Minecraft doesnt say who caused the death and this mod fixes it by checking for whoever placed that block.

Fixed kill credits:
-Sweet berries
-cacti
-dispensers
-dripstone/anvil
-wolfs
-lava/fire
-firework crossbow

Supported languages

-English
-Turkish
-Spanish
-French
-Italian

Supports basic kill counters such as:

/scoreboard objectives add Kills playerKillCount
/scoreboard objectives add TotalKills totalKillCount

Wouldn't recommend changing the configs.
